verdict.line: You lose if you let Urgot kite with Q and chip you with Passive at range; you win any all-in where you land E into full combo before level 6.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser vs Urgot sits at 48.5% over 1212 games despite Morde holding the lane-advantage and solo-kill-advantage flags — this is a matchup about forcing melee range, not winning passive trades. Urgot's Passive (Echoing Flames) and Q (Corrosive Charge) punish you for standing in auto-attack range doing nothing, so every point you're not actively threatening E (Death's Grasp) you're losing the exchange.

theirWindow.when: Disdain is up and you're overextended
theirWindow.what: If Urgot's E is available he can flip you and shield through your damage mid-trade. Don't greedily hold melee range to auto him down when his E is off cooldown — bait it first or wait it out.

yourWindow.when: Disdain just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: The 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown on E means a whiffed Disdain is a 14+ second window where Urgot has no escape or shield. Land Q (Obliterate) into E (Death's Grasp) immediately and commit to the extended trade.

start.why: 72% pick rate at 49.4% win over 1063 games — the extra sustain and AP lets you absorb Urgot's Q poke without losing the trade math.

boots.why: 85.8% pick rate; Urgot's Passive and auto resets are physical-damage attack procs, and Steelcaps' flat reduction blunts every one of them across the whole lane.

core.why: The highest-picked first core item; the slow from your Q/E lets you stick through Urgot's Disdain cooldown windows instead of letting him walk away.
47.5% win in the Rylai's-into-Riftmaker-into-Liandry's line; the omnivamp and empowered damage carry extended trades once you've locked him in melee.
56.1% win rate in the Rylai's/Riftmaker/Thornmail path — directly punishes a Passive- and auto-attack-reliant kit like Urgot's.

situational.when: he builds any tankiness and you need the burn to shred through sustained HP
the Urgot is running magic-leaning support assists or you need more raw sustain in long trades
he's rushing lifesteal or healing to offset your Riftmaker omnivamp

runes.keystoneWhy: 48.9% of games run Flash+Ignite alongside Conqueror; the stacking adaptive force and the healing on full stacks reward exactly the extended melee trades this matchup demands.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the top combo at 48.9% win and 78.5% pick rate — Ignite punishes the all-in you're forcing when R lands and he can't just walk out of your kill range.

playing.title: Never auto outside E range
playing.detail: Standing in his auto range without threatening E just feeds his Passive (Echoing Flames) procs and Q poke for free. Only step forward when E is live.

playing.title: Bait Disdain before committing
playing.detail: Urgot's E (Disdain) shields him and knocks you aside if he catches you dashing in blind. Walk up short, let him whiff or use it early, then commit your Q-E combo.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown windows
playing.detail: His E sits on a 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown — once it's down you have no reason to hold back. Land E into Q immediately and stay on him.

playing.title: Use R to flip executes
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) steals his stats and removes his Passive flame procs and R execute threat entirely for the duration. Save it specifically for the moment he goes for his own execute threshold.

playing.title: Track his W charge count
playing.detail: Purge (W) unloads on champions he's recently hit and triggers Echoing Flames — if he's already landed Q on you, back off briefly rather than standing through the Purge unload.

playing.title: Shield through poke, don't waste it
playing.detail: W (Indestructible) banks damage taken into a shield you can convert to healing. Pop it to heal after he lands Q poke rather than holding it defensively through a trade you're winning.

playing.title: Push waves pre-6, hold post-6
playing.detail: Before level 6 you're behind in pure poke trading, so shove minions and deny him easy Q value. After 6, your R turns every stand-still into a kill threat, so hold position and invite the fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and the win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the power-curve breakdown, trade patterns, and ability-tell reads are my own tactical analysis, not pulled from that dataset.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s (P) and (E). Use your abilities to fight him in melee combat to easily gain control over lane.
